title: Boa My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible yɛ kwa ma obiara, daa. Sɛ ɛboa wo a, wobɛtumi aboa ma kanea no nkɔ so nhyerɛn.
lead: Kenkan, bɔ mpae, kyɛ, san yɛ bio.
sub: Ɛyɛ kwa ma obiara, daa. Sɛ ɛboa wo a, wobɛtumi aboa ma kanea no nkɔ so nhyerɛn.
kofiSub: Prɛko, anaa ɔsram biara. Fa kaad, Apple Pay anaa Google Pay so, wonhia sɛ wokyerɛw wo din.
leave: Ɛbue wɔ krataafa foforo so. Sɛ woawie a, san bra ha, anaa kɔ Bible no so.
btcSub: On-chain anaa Lightning, tẽẽ kɔ yɛn ankasa yɛn server so, a ntamgyinafoɔ anaa obi foforo biara nni mu.
where:
• Server a ɛma sync ne akuw kɔ so yɛ adwuma.
  • Domain din no, na myquietbible.com akɔ so ayɛ adwuma.
  • Email a ɛde kɔ mu code mane.
never: Biribiara a ɛwɔ Bible no mu rento mu da. Akyɛdeɛ yɛ aseda, ɛnyɛ kwan a wode bɛkɔ mu, na biribiara nsesa wɔ app no mu sɛ wode bi ma anaa wommfa mma.
tax: My Quiet Bible nyɛ mmoa kuw a wɔakyerɛw no din wɔ aban mu, enti wɔntumi mfa akyɛdeɛ no nyi tow mu.
otherH: Akwan foforo a wobɛfa so aboa
other:
• Bɔ mpae ma saa adwuma yi, ne nnipa a wɔde kenkan.
  • Fa myquietbible.com mane obi a ɔpɛ Bible a ɛyɛ komm.
